headline: When climate diplomacy breaks down, Africa pays the price: What should TZ do next?
summary: UN climate talks in Antalya, Turkey, collapsed after the EU and others rejected a final deal proposed by the COP31 presidents of Turkey and Australia as too weak. A Tanzanian commentary argues Africa bears the cost.
why: Climate negotiations shape carbon-pricing, energy transition and climate-finance commitments that affect energy, industrial and emerging-market investment.
